cases.title: U takes the 'cannot save over an unreadable record' hold off when it brings back a good record, and REDO of the damage puts it back on
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written 1 Nov 2026 from the PR
cases.expected: The command line holds exactly TWO lines '[CE] Not saved to the CE record (CE's own record save): the CE record in this drawing could not be read, so CE does not save over it. The original record stays in the drawing; drafting carries on.' (after the first and second CDREBUILD) and THREE '[CE] CDREBUILD complete:' lines. The record reads damaged after the setup and after REDO, good after the U at (h), and good after the last CDREBUILD. The Civil log has '[ProjectData] The CE record in this drawing exists but could not be read'.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit test drives the hold class with true/false answers; only AutoCAD runs the real re-read at the end of U and REDO and shows whether the next CE save is skipped.
not_automated: Nothing to see: text only. Whether each U took back exactly the step named here is read from the record, not from what U showed (the U lines are recorded).
